overview_description.description:
Secoda is the self-serve data discovery tool that saves teams thousands of hours every year by making data discovery, trust, and understanding faster and easier.

Today, data teams are collecting tons of data, but most employees don't know what data exists, how to use it, and what data to trust. This confusion happens because different components of company data get collected in fragmented tools. Teams use dbt and Snowflake for data cataloging, Google Sheets for events, Confluence for general knowledge, Slack to manage data requests, Mode for reports, Github, Looker, the list goes on and on.

Secoda lets teams manage their queries, charts, data catalog, data dictionary, and documentation in one place.

After teams switch to Secoda, data knowledge is centralized in one place. Instead of having to switch between Snowflake, dbt, Confluence Google Sheets, BI tool, and your query editor, Secoda keeps all your data knowledge in one place for everyone who needs it.

about_short_description.short_description: Secoda is a collaborative workspace that enables data teams to share metadata, queries, charts, and documentation.

product.name: Secoda Data Catalog
product.description: A centralized platform that automatically ingests and organizes metadata from various data sources to provide a unified view of an organization's data assets, enabling efficient data discovery and understanding.

product.name: Secoda Data Governance
product.description: A platform to enforce data access policies, manage permissions, and ensure compliance with regulations through automated workflows and role-based access control.

product.name: Secoda Data Observability and Monitoring
product.description: A system for real-time monitoring of data health, quality, and query performance to detect anomalies and maintain data integrity.

product.name: Secoda AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that automates data documentation, query generation, and metadata editing to streamline data workflows.

product.name: Secoda Chrome Extension
product.description: A browser extension that enables in-browser data discovery, metadata editing, and AI-powered search across integrated data tools.

product.name: Secoda Data Documentation
product.description: A tool to automate the creation, maintenance, and distribution of data documentation, including schemas, lineage, and quality metrics.
